input.quote: For the acceptance period and for a period of one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and thereafter for as long as the Software is covered by Maintenance Services and is used by Sparkling in accordance with this Agreement, Garman warrants that the Software shall perform in conformance with the Specifications in all material respects.
input.rationale: Section 12 gives an express conformance warranty for the Software running through the 30-business-day acceptance period, for one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and then evergreen for as long as Maintenance Services are in place — at or above the preferred 12-month software warranty. Conformance is measured against the Specifications (the documented standard), and there is a real remedy: Garman must provide Software Repair Service at no additional charge (p0077), Sparkling may reject the Software with a full refund of all amounts paid during acceptance (p0053/p0057), and Section 15 leaves direct damages available rather than capping us to repair. Critically, there is no "AS IS" clause or disclaimer of implied warranties anywhere in the document, so nothing swallows the express warranty. Noted but not flagged as deviations: there is no separate professional/workmanlike warranty for the implementation, training and maintenance services, no compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranty, and post-acceptance repair does not expressly escalate to replacement or refund. These are sub-elements of the preferred wording; the material terms (period, conformance standard, remedy) meet or exceed the preferred position, so no redline is warranted.
